newsitem.title: USA: Wis. stadium board agrees to follow oversight plan.
newsitem.headline: Wis. stadium board agrees to follow oversight plan.

text.p: The board responsible for construction of a Milwaukee Brewers baseball park has agreed to follow new oversight rules awaiting adoption by the Wisconsin Legislature, a spokesman said Friday.
The Board of the Southeast Wisconsin Professional Baseball Park District voted unanimously Thursday in support of the legislation, spokesman Michael Morgan said.

Wisconsin senators have approved a bill to limit the board's powers and delete the state's moral obligation on insured tax-exempt sales tax revenue bonds sold for the construction of the stadium now called Miller Park.

The proposal requires the board to make quarterly financial reports to legislative leaders and an annual forecast, based on the best available data, of when a 0.1 percent five-county sales tax used to back the $146.7 million revenue bonds can be eliminated.
Wisconsin representatives have not yet considered the bill, which has been placed on the back burner while lawmakers work on the state's biennium budgeting plans.
